column1: # Anomaly: ISRC Mismatch — Same track registered under two ISRCs
# Scenario: "Electric Pulse" was accidentally registered with a second ISRC (USXR72024001A)
# by a sub-distributor. This splits the stream/royalty data across two identifiers
# causing both to appear as low-volume works and suppressing the per-stream rate calculation.
# The AI should detect the two ISRCs correspond to the same registered ISWC.
